title: NATURE, ECO, AND ADVENTURE TOURISM
description: Examines natural resource-based tourism issues in both domestic and international contexts, with examples from around the world.  Explores distinctions between nature-based tourism and other forms of tourism (e.g., traditional mass tourism, adventure tourism, ecotourism), positive and negative impacts of natural resource-based tourism (e.g., social, cultural, economic, environmental), and other related issues such as marketing, accreditation and certification, poverty and pro-poor tourism, and sustainable design.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: TR 2pm-3:50pm in PFSC 315 - Peavy Forest Science Center 315 (9/23 to 12/4)
